newsitem.title: BURKINA FASO: Burkina Faso students resume class, to hold talks.
newsitem.headline: Burkina Faso students resume class, to hold talks.

text.p: Students in Burkina Faso voted on Monday to suspend a strike over grants, allowances and conditions in return for a government offer of talks on their grievances.
Monday's meeting, grouping several hundred students at Ougadougou University, decided to resume classes until Thursday and then review developments. The strike began on January 29.
"We have decided to go to the ministry, meet the minister and see what he has to offer," National Association of Burkinabe Students leader Andre Tibiri told Reuters.
The vote followed a government decision on Saturday to free Tibiri and three other detained student leaders, and, if classes resumed, to enter talks.
Police used teargas last week to break up protests by students demanding the release of their leaders.
